FAQ and Rules

Rules
  1. /hlgg/ is a blue (safe for work) board. Threads and images are intended to be safe for work.
  2. You must be 18 or older to use or browse any Holotower service.

For testing emojis or formatting, please search our catalog for the testing thread.

img.c_emoji {
    width: 30px;
}

If you believe something is wrong

  • The site is broken in some way. Check status.holotower.org first.

Parts of Holotower

/hlgg/ - Hololive Global
/hlgg/ is the primary board on Holotower.org.
The archive
Set file to has file to return only posts that have a file.
Holotower is not a booru.

Holotower does not emulate, mirror, scrape, or otherwise host content from booru galleries.

Common questions
What is /hlgg/?

/hlgg/ is the short name of Hololive Global.

How long does a thread last?

A thread lasts until it falls off the board, but it will be available on our archive.
